about: An atproto network on this machine: its own PDSs, PLC directory, relay and Jetstream. Its accounts live in its own directory, not the public one, so Bluesky cannot find anything here. An app is handed this network's addresses (snowglobe env), not Bluesky's.
accountsNote: Every account on the network, on each of its 3 PDSs.
services: Resolves each did:plc to its keys and PDS
Crawls each PDS and merges their changes into one firehose
The relay's firehose as JSON, for apps (and this page)
Resolves handles, DIDs and records from this network only
Catches every message the PDSs send
Browses this network's repos and records
